name.zh-CN: 工程图标注；语义拓扑角色及来源诊断

description: Report only typed, source-linked dimensions and center geometry present in the formal DrawingModel; retain feature provenance, distinguish observable from unobservable machining requirements, and report countersink geometry and annotation capability independently. including fixed-section Sweep profile/path dimensions and their observability limits. Do not infer Loft station diameters, widths or internal profile dimensions from a silhouette. Report NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_CURRENT_DRAWING unless a formal section or other typed witness directly exposes the station. G7C: reference generated topology only within fixed-binormal planar Line/Arc Sweeps and aligned ruled Lofts; Hole uses caps only, while Fillet/Chamfer uses an explicit intersection of generated face roles. Preserve source Feature, role, and Sketch entity/adjacent ordered-section IDs; never persist OCP Face/Edge ordinals. Re-resolve with tolerances after rebuild and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.
execution_steps: Enumerate formal dimensions and their feature targets
Enumerate generated center marks and centerlines
Classify requested items as ANNOTATED, RECOGNIZED_BUT_NOT_RENDERED, UNSUPPORTED, or AMBIGUOUS
Identify Hole and Pattern provenance from EngineeringModel/rebuild evidence when available
Keep edge-treatment feature/source provenance when associating displayed geometry; do not treat a projected arc as a requested Fillet dimension unless typed dimension evidence exists.

Associate any available revolved profile, axis, and analytic cylindrical/conical surface evidence with its source Feature; do not invent diameter or axis dimensions that are absent from typed DrawingModel evidence.

Classify each requested dimension as OBSERVABLE, ANNOTATED_FROM_VALIDATED_FEATURE, REQUIRES_SECTION_VIEW, NOT_OBSERVABLE, or UNSUPPORTED; a feature parameter alone is not proof that a drawing expresses the dimension.
For Section A-A, verify its section plane, viewing direction, exact-section model digest provenance, loop and hatch counts, and stated sampling tolerance before describing internal geometry.
Keep sections and dimensions tied to the current model rebuild; after a model edit, regenerate the drawing and do not reuse stale annotation values.
Enumerate the formal associative-dimension index by stable annotation_id and verify each resolved entry links to exactly one DrawingDimension and one layout in its stated view.

Resolve FeatureParameter and BodyEnvelope references only against the current EngineeringModel v2 and its validated Spatial evidence; opaque face evidence ids are canonical descriptors, never OCP indices.
On rebuild, recompute association values and witnesses; omit suppressed features and reject stale or ambiguous references without proximity rebinding.
Retain the existing requested-item observability classification and report unsupported feature-linked dimensions explicitly.

For Countersink, verify actual analytic conical geometry separately from the drawing callout; report GEOMETRY_SUPPORTED=PASS and ANNOTATION_SUPPORTED=PARTIAL when no typed mouth-diameter/included-angle dimension exists.
For ExplicitPlacementPattern, verify instance geometry against the EngineeringModel placements but do not invent a pattern-spacing callout for nonuniform positions.

For Sweep requests, identify the engineering profile and Path parameters separately; mark profile dimensions or internal path placement NOT_OBSERVABLE when the current views and typed annotations do not establish them, and request a section/auxiliary view where supported.
Keep the source EngineeringModel section parameters separate from measured DrawingModel curves; report missing station-specific evidence explicitly.
For a generated Sweep/Loft reference, capture the source Feature, semantic face role, Sketch entity identity, or adjacent ordered Loft section pair from the EngineeringModel.
validation_gates: Only DrawingModel evidence counts as annotated
A tolerance is annotated only when a typed specification is attached
Unsupported GD&T, datum, and roughness requirements remain explicit
A projected circle alone does not prove a Hole or Counterbore annotation exists
Do not infer an axis, diameter, or angular dimension from projected appearance alone; only typed source-linked DrawingModel evidence counts as an annotation.
Never infer an internal blind depth from an ordinary orthographic opening; require a formal section or typed linked dimension.
A Section A-A boundary proves only the material cut it actually displays; do not claim it contains a feature-specific machining callout unless a typed DrawingDimension references that feature.
A resolved associative record must have a current geometry digest, exact evidence ids, matching EngineeringModel value, a measured Drawing projection, and a legal view layout.
Unsupported or section-required records do not count as rendered dimensions.
SVG paths and screen pixels are never used to reconstruct engineering values.
A visible countersink cone is not a typed countersink dimension or standards-compliant callout.
Do not represent nonuniform explicit placements with an invented uniform pitch, spacing, or circular pattern annotation.
Do not infer a Sweep profile size, path radius, or hidden Path segment from a silhouette alone; preserve the EngineeringModel parameter evidence separately from drawing observability.
Any Loft claim requires actual ordered section references and the validated current EngineeringModel rebuild; never infer unsupported topology or hidden section size.
Generated face and edge roles re-resolve against current source geometry with explicit tolerances; zero or multiple matches fail closed, with no persisted OCP ordinals.
failure_policy: Never add unassociated text as a dimension
Do not modify geometry to fit annotations
Do not claim standards compliance without a standards validator
On stale, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported topology, preserve the original error code and stop; never retarget by face/edge order.
G7C：在固定 binormal 的平面 Line/Arc Sweep 与 aligned ruled Loft 范围内引用生成拓扑；Hole 仅使用端盖，Fillet/Chamfer 使用明确的生成面交线。所有引用保留来源 Feature、角色及草图实体/相邻有序截面 ID，不保存 OCP Face/Edge 编号；上游重建后按公差重解析，零匹配或多匹配必须失败关闭。
